technical.title: Inventory system
technical.prompt:
Inventory System

You're building an inventory system for a game. Items can be added, removed, and used. Some items have passive effects that modify a player's stats while held.

No UI needed.

Phase 1: Add & Remove

Implement add() and remove().

Rules:

Respects inventory capacity

remove fails gracefully if the quantity exceeds what's held.

Phase 2: Use

Implement use().

Consumes item (like a potion or ammo)
Executes the item's use effect, if one is defined
Not all items are usable

Phase 3: Passive Effects

Passive effects apply while an item is in the inventory.

Example: holding a "Ring of Strength" (+5 attack) and a "Shield of Vitality" (+10 health)`.

Phase 4: Serialization

Implement save / load functionality for the inventory

Bonus

If time permits, pick one:

Events: Emit events (onItemAdded, onItemUsed, onItemRemoved) so external systems can React to inventory changes.

Conditional passives: Some passives only activate under conditions (e.g. "while health is below 50%"). How would you model this?
